claims.text: IVIG (1–2 g/kg over 2–7 days) has shown efficacy in steroid-resistant cases or flares during steroid taper;
claims.quote: IVIG in a dose of 1–2 g/kg over 2–7 days has shown efficacy in steroid‐resistant cases or in managing flare‐ups during steroid tapering.

claims.text: used more often in children, esp < 6 y;
claims.quote: Analysis of pediatric DRESS cases reveals that IVIG is employed more frequently in children, particularly those under 6 years of age.
The role of IVIG therapy in DRESS remains uncertain due to the absence of controlled clinical trials, with existing evidence primarily derived from case reports and case series.

claims.text: Severe DRESS w life-threatening comp (multiorgan, resp failure, ♡): plasmapheresis may be considered when other tx fail.
claims.quote: In cases of severe DRESS with life‐threatening complications, such as multiorgan involvement, respiratory failure, or cardiac involvement, mechanistic therapies like therapeutic plasma exchange (plasmapheresis) may be considered when other treatments fail.
